# Milestone brief — ui-uplift-m11

**Title:** Author the four empty states (cause + one action)
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** ui-uplift (plans/ui-uplift/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-09-26 -> 2026-10-03

## Parent epic

- ui-uplift-e2 — Finish debt — every server-emitted class ships with its CSS rule
  Four class families shipped with zero CSS rule anywhere in the stylesheet. The root cause the current-state critic traced nearly every HIGH finding to: feature milestones shipped complete, tested, secure behaviour and left CSS as an afterthought scoped to "does it render", not "does it look finished" — because no milestone's acceptance criteria ever said "style this". This epic closes the backlog AND lands the standing rule as a derived test so it cannot regenerate.

## Summary

UPL-21. The four empty states are italic centred grey text with zero action affordance. Each already carries a cause in its copy; the missing half is turning the implied action into an actual control. HARD-PAIRED with the index reorder — the copy says "Create one above" / "Add one above", which becomes wrong the moment the form moves.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given any of the four empty states, when rendered, then it states a cause and offers one actual control, not a pointer to a form elsewhere on the page
2. Given ui-uplift-m12 has shipped, then this ships AFTER it and re-decides the interim empty-state copy m12 left behind, which currently points at the Manage disclosure rather than offering a control
3. Given the source pattern leads with an icon, then either the anatomy is adopted WITHOUT the icon, or the product's first icon is an explicit recorded decision

## Depends on

- ui-uplift-m12 — Corpus before machinery — reorder the detail page (v0) [status: done]
